exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: Tengo una alergia grave al cacahuate.
exchange.en: I have a severe peanut allergy.

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: No puedo comer nada que contenga cacahuate.
exchange.en: I cannot eat anything containing peanut.

cards.title: Send the card to the kitchen

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: ¿Puede mostrarle esta tarjeta a la persona que prepara la comida?
exchange.en: Can you show this card to the person preparing the food?

exchange.speaker: staff
exchange.es: Voy a preguntarle a la cocina.
exchange.en: I’m going to ask the kitchen.

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: ¿Se prepara en la misma superficie o con los mismos utensilios?
exchange.en: Is it prepared on the same surface or with the same utensils?

exchange.speaker: staff
exchange.en: Yes, we use the same surface.

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: Entonces no voy a comer aquí.
exchange.en: Then I’m not going to eat here.

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: Gracias por decírmelo. No voy a arriesgarme.
exchange.en: Thank you for telling me. I’m not going to take the risk.
